record_fields.action: float32[3]: forward m/s, yaw rate rad/s, vertical m/s (up)

state_fields.name: distance_to_target_m
state_fields.definition: horizontal distance from the drone to the target's centre, m

state_fields.name: bearing_to_target_rad
state_fields.definition: bearing of the target relative to the drone's heading, rad in [-pi, pi], positive to the right (|r| 0.92 / 0.88 with a motion-based estimate on the real episodes)

state_fields.name: altitude_minus_1_47_m
state_fields.definition: altitude above ground minus 1.47 m (|r| 0.986 / 0.996; fitted 0.985 z - 1.470, 0.987 z - 1.477)

state_fields.name: speed_m_s
state_fields.definition: speed: the norm of the velocity vector, m/s

state_fields.name: yaw_rate_rad_s
state_fields.definition: yaw rate, rad/s, positive clockwise seen from above (|r| 0.54 / 0.76)

state_fields.name: x_from_start_m
state_fields.definition: x (north) relative to the episode's start, m

state_fields.name: y_from_start_m
state_fields.definition: y (east) relative to the episode's start, m
